description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kubernetes, Vault, and system metrics within a health check context, including fetching kubeconfig from Vault, Kubernetes API interactions, system metric collection, and reporting functions.

classes.name: HealthResult
classes.description: Dataclass representing the structured health report including site info, status, nodes, pods, connectivity, and metrics.

methods.name: List[str] _vault_candidate_urls(vault_addr: str, secret_path: str)
methods.description: Build candidate URLs for Vault KV v2 and direct path styles.

methods.name: str _extract_kubeconfig_from_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extract kubeconfig content from a given Vault payload.

methods.name: None _log_vault_start(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, timeout: float)
methods.description: Log the start of a Vault request.

methods.name: None _log_vault_end(logger: logging.Logger, status_code: int)
methods.description: Log the end of a Vault request.

methods.name: None _log_vault_error(logger: logging.Logger, url: str, exc: Exception)
methods.description: Log an error encountered during Vault request.

methods.name: logging.Logger setup_logging(level: str = "INFO")
methods.description: Initialize logging with a specified level, returning a logger instance.

methods.name: str fetch_kubeconfig_from_vault(vault_addr: str, token: str, secret_path: str, timeout: float = 8.0)
methods.description: Retrieve kubeconfig content from Vault given address, token, and secret path.

methods.name: Tuple[client.CoreV1Api,client.AppsV1Api] build_k8s_client_from_kubeconfig(kubeconfig_content: str)
methods.description: Create Kubernetes API clients from kubeconfig content.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_nodes(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, label_selector: str)
methods.description: List Kubernetes nodes with their labels, conditions, and readiness.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_pods(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, label_selector: str)
methods.description: List Pods in a namespace with their status, labels, and container info.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_metrics_from_text(log_text: str)
methods.description: Parse radio access metrics from log text.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] _safe_exec_command(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod: str, container: str, command: List[str], timeout_seconds: int = 8)
methods.description: Execute a command in a container and retrieve stdout, stderr, and exit code heuristically.

methods.name: Optional[float] _parse_cpu_from_top(output: str)
methods.description: Parse CPU utilization from 'top' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Optional[float]] _parse_mem_from_free(output: str)
methods.description: Parse memory usage from 'free -m' command output.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _parse_df_h(output: str)
methods.description: Parse disk usage from 'df -h' command output.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _parse_sctp_ss(output: str)
methods.description: Parse SCTP status from `ss` command output.

methods.name: List[str] _container_names_from_pod(pod: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extract container names from a pod dict.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _collect_single_container_metrics( core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod_name: str, cname: str )
methods.description: Collect CPU, memory, disk, and SCTP metrics for a container.

methods.name: None _collect_cpu_metric(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod_name: str, cname: str, cont_res: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collect CPU utilization metrics for a container.

methods.name: None _collect_memory_metric(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod_name: str, cname: str, cont_res: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collect memory usage metrics for a container.

methods.name: None _collect_disk_metric(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod_name: str, cname: str, cont_res: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collect disk usage metrics for a container.

methods.name: None _collect_sctp_metric(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod_name: str, cname: str, cont_res: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Collect SCTP status for a container.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _collect_container_system_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Aggregate system metrics for all containers in a pod.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] collect_logs_and_metrics(core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], max_bytes: int = 50000)
methods.description: Fetch logs and system metrics for a list of pods.

methods.name: None _process_pod_metrics( core_api: client.CoreV1Api, namespace: str, pod: Dict[str, Any], max_bytes: int, aggregated: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Process logs and gather container metrics for a specific pod, updating an aggregate dict.

methods.name: None _append_radio_anomalies(pod_name: str, radio_metrics: Dict[str, Any], aggregated: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Append radio metric anomalies based on thresholds.

methods.name: None _append_resource_anomalies(pod_name: str, container_metrics: Dict[str, Any], aggregated: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Append resource pressure anomalies if CPU/memory usage exceeds thresholds.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] tcp_connectivity_check(host: Optional[str], port: int, timeout: float)
methods.description: Attempt TCP connection to a host and port within a timeout, reporting success and latency.

methods.name: HealthResult build_health_report( site_id: Optional[str], environment: str, nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]], pods: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any], metrics: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Construct a comprehensive health report from nodes, pods, connectivity, and metrics.

methods.name: bool _all_nodes_ready(nodes: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Check if all nodes are in Ready state.

methods.name: bool _all_pods_running(pods: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Check if all listed pods are in 'Running' phase.

methods.name: str _derive_status(node_ready: bool, pods_running: bool, anomalies: List[Dict[str, Any]], connectivity: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Determine overall health status based on nodes, pods, anomalies, and connectivity.

methods.name: None send_to_kafka(bootstrap_servers: str, topic: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Send a health report payload to Kafka topic.

methods.name: None push_to_loki(loki_url: str, tenant_id: Optional[str], labels: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], logger: logging.Logger)
methods.description: Push logs/entries to Loki via HTTP API, with optional tenant ID and labels.

methods.name: Optional[float] _num_from(s: str)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: delivery(err, msg)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
